title: An immersion representing a single direct-image rank condition
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be flat, proper and locally of finite presentation. Assume the structure-sheaf adjunction unit $\mathcal O_T\to p_*p^*\mathcal O_T$ is an isomorphism for every base change $g:T\to S$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let E and F be finite locally free modules on X. There exist a scheme W and an immersion j:W\to S such that, for every test g:T\to S, g factors through j if and only if R_1(f,E,F,g) holds [def-sc-picard-universal-single-rank-match]. The conclusion concerns only F, not an additional direct image of its dual.

proof.text: Choose standard derived-category localizations for all scheme module categories and all their open over-sites. This is Mathlib HasDerivedCategory.standard and adds no hypothesis to the existing statement.

The predicate R_1 is base-change stable: specialize its universal quantifier to the composite of the new test with the base-change map. Congruence and categorical associativity identify its two rank witnesses with the required ones. Its source locality is precisely the source-local theorem.

For each s take its perfect chart. Apply the existing perfect lowest-cohomology locus theorem on this U with a=0, upper bound b and rank r. Keep its immersion and universal factorization criterion. Compose that equivalence with the inverse chart comparison to show that this immersion represents R_1 on U.

Apply the generic local-immersion gluing theorem to these local representatives, base-change stability and source locality. It gives the desired global immersion and the unchanged factorization equivalence.

proof_origin.place: first three proof paragraphs, applying Tag 0BDL locally and gluing the characterized loci
proof_origin.note: V2 realizes the original four-step route in Lean: a local perfect chart, the existing lowest-cohomology locus theorem, source locality, and generic gluing. The three unfinished pieces are strictly parts of the argument.

lean.statement: theorem exists_picardUniversalSingleRankLocus {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S), IsIso ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf))) (E F : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] [F.IsFiniteLocallyFree] : ∃ (W : Scheme.{u}) (j : W ⟶ S), IsImmersion j ∧ ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S), (∃ h : T ⟶ W, h ≫ j = g) ↔ PicardUniversalSingleRankMatch f E F g
